definitions.gloss: pensiveness; reverie; being lost in thought
definitions.explanation: Thinking deeply and quietly about something, often with a touch of melancholy or longing, so that one is absorbed and still. Almost always in {物思|ものおも}いにふける (to be lost in thought). Literary in tone.

examples.japanese: {物思|ものおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧。

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{物思|ものおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふけっていた→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧。
examples.english: She was lost in thought, gazing out of the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つい{物思|ものおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふけって→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Autumn nights are long, and when I am alone I tend to fall into reverie.

notes:
⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (things) + ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (thought). Associated with autumn in poetry ({物思|ものおも}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧) and with love: in classical poetry {物思|ものおも}い often means the sorrow of love.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物思|ものおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧ / ⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧: to be lost in thought
- {物思|ものおも}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧: autumn, the season for reverie
- {物思|ものおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}んだ→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a pensive face
